'''Trak-Tex''' was a technology company that produced [[Grab-Field Generator]]s that produced a [[tractor field]] capable of scooping ions from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and feeding them into the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor's]] [[solar gather-panel]]s.
